name: January
summary: Holiday in the Park finishes in early January at Magic Mountain. Once school resumes, crowds usually ease, but operating days vary by park and a quiet weekday can also be a closed one.

verdict.short: January at these parks: one of the year's best windows. The quietest month on this site.
worstFor: The Chicago and New Jersey parks

crowds.shape: The quietest month on this site — school in session everywhere, cold in the north keeping the indoor-averse home, and full ride days at the SoCal and Florida parks for whoever shows up.

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The Six Flags parks in the north run limited or weekend-only calendars this month — verify daily operation before booking anything non-refundable.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: At Magic Mountain, choose a listed Holiday in the Park date in early January if you want lights and shows. Check regular park hours for visits later in the month.

freshness.sourceNote: Holiday timing checked November 4, 2026 against [Magic Mountain’s event calendar](https://www.sixflags.com/magicmountain/events). Crowd and cost estimates describe multi-year patterns. Weather figures are regional climate normals.
